title: wolfssl provider: PBKDF2 via wc_PKCS5_PBKDF2
description: Implement the KDF provider callback for PBKDF2 in the wolfssl provider. wc_PKCS5_PBKDF2 in wolfcrypt.ko accepts password, salt, iterations, and output length. The provider glues: (1) password from fd state inbuf (populated via write()), (2) salt from crypto2dev_kdf_op.salt, (3) iterations from crypto2dev_kdf_op.kdf.pbkdf2.iterations (minimum 1000 enforced at framework layer, check again here), (4) key length = target algo key size, (5) output written directly to key_ctx key material, zeroized after. Depends on WOLFKM-ely (UAPI struct) and WOLFKM-nid (design/callback contract).
